urology-zhang-xu.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
urology-zhang-xu.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; director of the Urology Institute at PLA General Hospital; chair of the Chinese Urological Association; founder of laparoscopic and robotic urology in China.
urology-zhang-xu.focus: Urological tumours (prostate, kidney, bladder), robotic and laparoscopic minimally invasive surgery, kidney transplantation.
urology-zhang-xu.achievement: Originated the retroperitoneal laparoscopic technique system; his team completed Asia's first 10,000 da Vinci robotic procedures, driving a leap in minimally invasive urology in China.
urology-zhang-xu.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

urology-zhou-li-qun.achievement: Laparoscopic and robotic surgery for urological tumours, kidney-sparing surgery.
urology-zhou-li-qun.honors: Clinical research on kidney and bladder cancer.

urology-zheng-jun-hua.achievement: Kidney transplantation and minimally invasive urology.

urology-lin-tian-xin.achievement: Precision diagnosis of bladder cancer and bladder-preserving integrated treatment.

urology-wei-qiang.achievement: Robotic surgery for prostate cancer and multidisciplinary urological oncology care.

urology-sun-ying-hao.focus: Prostate disease, urinary stones, minimally invasive surgery.

urology-huang-jian.focus: Bladder cancer, minimally invasive urological tumour surgery.

andrology-guo-ying-lu.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
andrology-guo-ying-lu.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; one of the founders of urology and andrology in China; established the country's first andrology centre; founder of the Chinese Society of Andrology.
andrology-guo-ying-lu.focus: Urinary stones, prostate disease, andrological disorders (sexual dysfunction, male infertility).
andrology-guo-ying-lu.achievement: Promoted the nationwide adoption of extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy and established the andrology care system and training mechanisms.
andrology-guo-ying-lu.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award; Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

andrology-li-hong-jun.achievement: Standardised care for male infertility and sexual dysfunction.

andrology-shang-xue-jun.achievement: Male reproduction and sperm quality research.

andrology-he-le-ye.achievement: Sexual medicine and male genital reconstruction.

andrology-jiang-hui.focus: Male infertility, sexual dysfunction, reproductive medicine.

general-surgery-zhao-yu-pei.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Sciences
general-surgery-zhao-yu-pei.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; honorary president of Peking Union Medical College Hospital; chair of the Chinese Surgical Society; an authority on pancreatic surgery in China.
general-surgery-zhao-yu-pei.focus: Pancreatic tumours, pancreatitis, biliary disease, complex abdominal surgery.
general-surgery-zhao-yu-pei.achievement: Led the establishment of China's pancreatic disease care system and standardised pancreatic cancer guidelines, improving the safety and outcomes of pancreatic surgery.
general-surgery-zhao-yu-pei.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

general-surgery-wang-xue-hao.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
general-surgery-wang-xue-hao.achievement: Living-donor liver transplantation and liver cancer surgery systems.
general-surgery-wang-xue-hao.honors: Research on liver transplantation and liver cancer.

general-surgery-zheng-shu-sen.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
general-surgery-zheng-shu-sen.achievement: The Hangzhou protocol for liver transplantation and hepatobiliary-pancreatic surgery.

general-surgery-zhou-jian.achievement: Early diagnosis of liver cancer and liver transplantation.
general-surgery-zhou-jian.honors: Research on precision treatment of liver cancer.

general-surgery-mao-yi-lei.achievement: Hepatobiliary surgery, liver imaging and liver function assessment.

endocrinology-ning-guang.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
endocrinology-ning-guang.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; former president of Ruijin Hospital; former chair of the Chinese Society of Endocrinology; an authority on endocrine and metabolic disease in China.
endocrinology-ning-guang.focus: Diabetes, obesity, metabolic syndrome, endocrine tumours and complex endocrine disease.
endocrinology-ning-guang.achievement: Led Chinese epidemiological studies of diabetes and metabolic syndrome; drove standardised endocrine care and the national Metabolic Management Centre (MMC) network.
endocrinology-ning-guang.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

endocrinology-ji-li-nong.achievement: Diabetes epidemiology and clinical research on glucose-lowering drugs.

endocrinology-teng-wei-ping.achievement: Epidemiology of thyroid disease and iodine nutrition research.

endocrinology-zhao-jia-jun.achievement: Lipotoxicity, thyroid and metabolic disease research.
endocrinology-zhao-jia-jun.honors: Research on mechanisms of metabolic disease.

endocrinology-liu-chao.achievement: Integrated traditional and Western medicine for thyroid nodules and hyperthyroidism.

endocrinology-yang-wen-ying.focus: Diabetes, pituitary and thyroid disease, obesity.

endocrinology-xing-xiao-ping.focus: Complex endocrine disease, rare endocrine tumours.

nephrology-chen-xiang-mei.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
nephrology-chen-xiang-mei.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; director of the Kidney Disease Institute at PLA General Hospital; former chair of the Chinese Society of Nephrology; an authority on nephrology in China.
nephrology-chen-xiang-mei.focus: Chronic kidney disease, IgA nephropathy, lupus nephritis, blood purification and kidney transplantation.
nephrology-chen-xiang-mei.achievement: Led the establishment of China's chronic kidney disease epidemiology database and treatment guidelines; advanced standardisation and domestic development of blood purification technology.
nephrology-chen-xiang-mei.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

nephrology-zhao-ming-hui.achievement: ANCA-associated vasculitis and lupus nephritis research.

nephrology-yu-xue-qing.achievement: Genetics and precision treatment of IgA nephropathy.

nephrology-mei-zhang-lin.achievement: Diagnosis and intervention in polycystic kidney disease.
nephrology-mei-zhang-lin.honors: National-level projects on polycystic kidney disease.

nephrology-ding-xiao-qiang.achievement: Acute kidney injury (AKI) and blood purification.
nephrology-ding-xiao-qiang.honors: Research on AKI early warning and dialysis.

hematology-huang-xiao-jun.title: Chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor
hematology-huang-xiao-jun.authority: Director of the Peking University Institute of Hematology; former chair of the Chinese Society of Hematology; a leader in hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in China.
hematology-huang-xiao-jun.focus: Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, leukaemia, aplastic anaemia, myeloproliferative neoplasms.
hematology-huang-xiao-jun.achievement: Originated the Beijing protocol for haploidentical stem cell transplantation, enabling transplantation for patients without an HLA-matched donor; adopted in international guidelines and used worldwide.
hematology-huang-xiao-jun.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation Science and Technology Progress Award.

hematology-hu-yu.achievement: Thrombosis and haemostasis, CAR-T and coagulation disorders.

hematology-li-jun-min.achievement: Precision treatment of leukaemia and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

hematology-liu-qi-fa.achievement: Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and prevention of GVHD.

hematology-jiang-qian.achievement: Molecular monitoring and treatment discontinuation in chronic myeloid leukaemia (CML).

stomatology-zhang-zhi-yuan.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
stomatology-zhang-zhi-yuan.authority: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering; director of the National Center for Stomatology; honorary president of the Chinese Stomatological Association; an authority on oral and maxillofacial surgery in China.
stomatology-zhang-zhi-yuan.focus: Oral and maxillofacial and head and neck tumours, functional reconstruction of maxillofacial defects, complex oral and maxillofacial surgery.
stomatology-zhang-zhi-yuan.achievement: Achieved internationally leading results in surgery and functional reconstruction for advanced oral and maxillofacial malignancies invading the skull base.
stomatology-zhang-zhi-yuan.honors: National Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class); Chinese Physician Award.

stomatology-wang-xing.achievement: Orthognathic surgery and craniofacial deformity correction.

stomatology-zhao-yi-min.title: Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
stomatology-zhao-yi-min.achievement: Maxillofacial defect rehabilitation and implant robotics.

stomatology-yu-guang-yan.focus: Salivary gland disease, oral and maxillofacial tumours, facial nerve repair.
